title: [bundle] Audit and fix fleet status dry-run semantics after CLI/MCP h
objective: Audit and fix fleet status dry-run semantics after CLI/MCP hardening. Current code appears to accept hf fleet status --dry-run even without --fix, which can silently imply a remediation dry-run while only status runs. Verify behavior, then make agent navigation fail closed or explicitly documented: dry-run should only be accepted with --fix or users should use hf fleet sync --dry-run. Update CLI help/docs/MCP if needed and add regression tests proving no silent no-op flag. Scope: hf/src/main.rs, hf/tests/**, hf/src/bin/hf-mcp.rs, AGENTS.md, docs/**, .handoff/**
acceptance_criteria: A regression test reproduces the defect, then asserts the fixed behavior; `cargo test` is green.
Drift audit passes: no out-of-scope write (edits stay within path_scope) and the intent_lock is unchanged.
